name: Motor Health / cwru-48k-v1
intended_use: Academic bearing-fault screening on the documented CWRU subset; human review only
input: Exactly 2048 finite drive-end acceleration samples in the CWRU source amplitude scale; declared nominal sampling rate 48000 Hz
output: Raw anomaly score, decision threshold, normal/anomaly decision, computed features, artifact version and input hash
training_data: One healthy 0 HP CWRU recording, 119 windows. RMS threshold is calibrated using validation labels.
selection: Validation balanced accuracy, validation AUC, then simplicity
excluded_uses: Unvalidated sensors, scale, sampling rate or bearing geometries
limitations: Seeded faults and shared conditions across loads
No drift job, durable prediction log or automatic retraining
monitoring_status: Input validation and health/version endpoint implemented; production monitoring and retraining are future handover work
